example.title: Miller homestead, silo, 2913 Kansas Highway 4
example.place: La Crosse vicinity, Rush County, KS

brief: Slender concrete stave silo about 14 ft across and 50 ft high, the short staves faded to chalky white-grey with a faint grid of joints and thin steel hoops, open-topped with a small weathervane on a rod at the rim. It rises out of a dense stand of cedars and elms at the edge of the farmyard, with a small red gable-front brooder house, corrugated-steel sheds and the grey horse barn nearby.
